notes: Native installer (claude.ai/install.sh|ps1|cmd) is recommended; README says npm install is deprecated. Also signed apt/dnf/apk repos (package 'claude-code'). Homebrew cask zap additionally lists ~/.config/claude, ~/.local/state/claude, ~/.cache/claude. Not the CLI: Claude desktop app (cask 'claude', winget Anthropic.Claude) and winget Anthropic.Ant ('ant', Claude Platform CLI).

Standalone installers chatgpt.com/codex/install.sh / install.ps1 (download from releases.openai.com/codex, fall back to GitHub Releases). Homebrew cask 'codex-app' (Codex desktop app) is deprecated/discontinued. PyPI 'codex' is an unrelated comic-reader server. VS Code extension id openai.chatgpt is branded 'Codex - OpenAI's coding agent'.

Being superseded by Antigravity CLI ('agy'): Google's developer blog post 'An important update: transitioning Gemini CLI to Antigravity CLI' (developers.googleblog.com) - individual/free tiers stopped being served 2026-06-18. Homebrew formula gemini-cli is deprecated (2026-06-18, replacement cask antigravity-cli). ~/.gemini is also used by Antigravity (~/.gemini/antigravity*), so its presence alone does not prove Gemini CLI. VS Code companion extension: Google.gemini-cli-vscode-ide-companion.
IDE extension only (no CLI). Per Google's Gemini CLI -> Antigravity CLI transition post, Code Assist IDE extensions stopped serving individual tiers on 2026-06-18; enterprise continues.

Successor to Gemini CLI. Install: antigravity.google/cli/install.sh | install.ps1 | install.cmd. Cask binary 'antigravity' is linked as 'agy'; Scoop also shims 'antigravity-cli.exe'. Config dir from Homebrew cask zap stanza.

Desktop app ('Antigravity 2', agent orchestration). No shell launcher documented in cask/scoop. The VS Code-style editor is now a separate product (antigravity-ide). The 'agy' name now belongs to Antigravity CLI.
Commands are the shell launchers the Homebrew cask links. winget Google.AntigravityIDE was previously named 'Antigravity'.

Official xAI terminal coding agent. Install: curl -fsSL https://x.ai/cli/install.sh | bash; irm https://x.ai/cli/install.ps1 | iex. npm @xai-official/grok is maintained by npm user xai-security <security@x.ai> (bin 'grok'), not mentioned in the docs page. Homebrew cask links the binary as both 'grok' and 'agent'. 'grok' collides with the community superagent-ai/grok-cli (same ~/.grok dir) and Homebrew's deprecated 'grok' regex tool; 'agent' collides with Cursor CLI. Windows user config: %USERPROFILE%\.grok\config.toml.

Not affiliated with xAI. README install: curl .../superagent-ai/grok-cli/main/install.sh | bash, or 'bun add -g grok-dev' (npm grok-dev, maintainer superagent-labs, bin grok). Older npm name @vibe-kit/grok-cli (bin grok, README 'Grok CLI', last publish 2025-11) is very likely the same project but no primary source links it - left out of packages. Shares 'grok' command and ~/.grok with xAI Grok Build; settings file ~/.grok/user-settings.json is specific to this tool.

Current Kimi agent (replaces Python kimi-cli). Install: code.kimi.com/kimi-code/install.sh | install.ps1. KIMI_CODE_HOME overrides ~/.kimi-code. 'kimi' command is shared with legacy kimi-cli. npm 'kimi-code' (whitesmith) is an unrelated claude-code proxy wrapper with bin 'kimi'.

Archived and no longer maintained; replaced by Kimi Code CLI (kimi-code), which migrates data from ~/.kimi. PyPI 'kimi-code' is an archived legacy alias of the same Python package (NOT the new Kimi Code CLI). Homebrew formula kimi-cli deprecated 2026-07-17 (replacement kimi-code). Was typically installed via 'uv tool install kimi-cli'.

Repo moved sst/opencode -> anomalyco/opencode (old URL redirects). Install script default fallback dir is ~/.opencode/bin (after $OPENCODE_INSTALL_DIR, $XDG_BIN_DIR, ~/bin). Desktop app: cask opencode-desktop, winget SST.OpenCodeDesktop, scoop extras/opencode-desktop. Kilo CLI is a fork and reads legacy opencode.json.

Personal multi-channel AI agent/gateway rather than a pure coding agent. ~/.openclaw is documented as the local-prefix install location (install-cli.sh); Hermes Agent docs also treat ~/.openclaw as OpenClaw's data dir. winget OpenClaw.OpenClawCompanion is the Windows desktop companion (no CLI).
Also standalone installer (install-qwen-standalone.sh/.ps1 on aliyuncs OSS). VS Code companion extension: qwenlm.qwen-code-vscode-ide-companion (publisher not domain-verified).
Rust coding-agent harness. Install: jcode.sh/install | install.ps1, brew (core formula jcode, also tap 1jehuang/jcode). PyPI 'jcode' (codewithjoe-tech) and npm 'jcode' are unrelated projects.
Install: mimo.xiaomi.com/install | install.ps1, or npm. MIMOCODE_HOME overrides all paths. winget Xiaomi.MiMoDesktop is the MiMo chat app, not the CLI.
Recommended install: 'pip install aider-install && aider-install' (installs aider-chat via uv). ~/.aider.conf.yml is a file (also read from git root and cwd).

npm @sourcegraph/cody latest 5.5.26 (bin cody). Current status unclear: Sourcegraph steers individual users to Amp; treat as legacy. '@sourcegraph/cody-agent' is a JSON-RPC agent for IDE plugins, not a CLI.

'crush' is a common word (PyPI 'crush' and winget kalink0.Crush are unrelated). Scoop needs custom bucket: scoop bucket add charm https://github.com/charmbracelet/scoop-bucket.git. Windows global config is %USERPROFILE%\.config\crush. CRUSH_GLOBAL_CONFIG / CRUSH_GLOBAL_DATA override.

Install: curl -fsSL https://app.factory.ai/cli | sh; irm https://app.factory.ai/cli/windows | iex. npm 'droid' and '@factory/cli' publish the same build. Docs moved docs.factory.ai -> docs.factory.com. Factory desktop app is a separate entry (factory-desktop).
No shell command documented; the v1 'factory' command name could not be confirmed in any primary source (the CLI is 'droid').

Repo moved block/goose -> aaif-goose/goose (redirects). CLI install: download_cli.sh from GitHub releases. cask block-goose and scoop extras/goose are the desktop app. Collides with Pressly 'goose' DB-migration tool (Homebrew formula 'goose', winget Pressly.Goose).

Homebrew formula 'cline' is deprecated (2026-05-18, non-FOSS deps). cask cline-app is Cline Desktop (no CLI). Default config/data dirs not documented (only --config/--data-dir flags). PyPI 'cline' is unrelated.

CLI is a fork of OpenCode; also reads legacy opencode.json and project .kilocode/. Install script: kilo.ai/cli/install. 'kilo' collides with antirez's kilo text editor. Docs say Windows config path 'may vary'.

Install: curl -fsSL https://blackbox.ai/install.sh | bash; iex (irm https://blackbox.ai/install.ps1). No version flag documented (docs list 'blackbox info'). npm @blackbox_ai/blackbox-cli (bin blackbox, repo llmcod/blackbox_cli) exists but is not referenced by official docs - excluded; '@blackbox/cli' from the marketing page is 404 on npm. Homebrew formula 'blackbox' is StackExchange's unrelated secrets tool.
Config dir not documented in fetched docs (likely ~/.augment, unverified).

Primary command is now 'agent' (docs); Homebrew cask still links it as 'cursor-agent'. Install: curl https://cursor.com/install -fsS | bash; irm 'https://cursor.com/install?win32=true' | iex; puts launcher in ~/.local/bin. 'agent' is a generic name (also linked by Grok Build cask). Config paths come from the Homebrew cask zap stanza (~/.local/share/cursor-agent is the install tree).
'cursor' shell launcher is the bundled VS Code-style CLI. Chocolatey id is 'cursoride' ('cursor' is 404).

Windsurf was rebranded Devin Desktop: Homebrew cask devin-desktop has old_tokens ['windsurf'] and still downloads from windsurf-stable.codeiumdata.com. winget still carries Codeium.Windsurf alongside CognitionAI.DevinDesktop. Cask zap also removes ~/.devin (shared with Devin CLI). Codeium.codeium = 'Windsurf Plugin (formerly Codeium)' for VS Code (publisher not domain-verified).
Install: curl -fsSL https://cli.devin.ai/install.sh | bash; irm https://static.devin.ai/cli/setup.ps1 | iex; or 'Install Devin CLI' from Devin Desktop. Version flag not documented.
~/.kiro is shared with Kiro CLI ('your .kiro configuration is shared across all of them'). Linux packages: apt/dnf 'kiro'.

displayName: Kiro CLI (formerly Amazon Q Developer CLI)
notes: Amazon Q Developer CLI was renamed Kiro CLI: Homebrew cask kiro-cli has old_tokens ['amazon-q','codewhisperer']; migration doc says 'q' and 'q chat' keep working. 'q' collides with Scoop main/q (harelba SQL-on-CSV) and Homebrew formula 'q' (natesales DNS client). ~/.aws/amazonq is the legacy Q config dir.
IDE extension. The Amazon Q Developer CLI ('q') is now Kiro CLI - see kiro-cli entry.
VS Code extension only; no official Roo Code CLI found (npm 'roo-cli' and '@roo-code/cli' are unrelated/404).
README: repository is no longer actively maintained and is read-only; final 2.0.0 release of extension, CLI and JetBrains plugin. Config dir (~/.continue) not confirmed in fetched primary sources.

COPILOT_HOME overrides ~/.copilot; older XDG locations are migrated. Install script gh.io/copilot-install uses PREFIX ($HOME/.local for non-root, /usr/local for root). 'copilot' collides with AWS Copilot CLI (Homebrew formula 'copilot', winget Amazon.CopilotCLI). Chocolatey 'copilot-cli' looks stale (1.0.12) vs 'github-copilot-cli' (1.0.91). Desktop app: cask github-copilot-app / winget GitHub.CopilotApp.

displayName: GitHub Copilot in the CLI (gh extension)
notes: Deprecated 2025-10-25 in favor of GitHub Copilot CLI. Not a standalone executable: installed with 'gh extension install github/gh-copilot' and run as 'gh copilot suggest|explain'; detect via 'gh extension list'.

Install: 'uv tool install openhands --python 3.12' or install.openhands.dev/install.sh. PyPI 'openhands' is the CLI; 'openhands-ai' is the main OpenHands (server/'Agent Canvas') package. npm 'openhands' is a security placeholder.

npm bins: codebuddy, cbc, codebuddy-code (plus helper bins cbc-prewarm, codebuddy-lowmem). Version: 'codebuddy -V/--version'. 'cbc' collides with COIN-OR CBC solver (Homebrew formula 'cbc'). CLI config dir not documented; ~/.codebuddy is documented for the IDE (see codebuddy-ide).
No shell launcher documented. Tencent-Cloud.coding-copilot = 'Tencent Cloud CodeBuddy' VS Code extension (publisher not domain-verified).
One-click installer: cloud.iflow.cn/iflow-cli/install.sh. npm latest 0.5.19 last modified 2026-05.

Coding-agent multiplexer (desktop app + CLI). Renamed Mux -> Xum after a Mux.com trademark concern; legacy npm 'mux' forwards to @coder/xum. Repo coder/mux redirects to coder/xum. 'mux' collides with Mux.com's video CLI and generic multiplexer tools. Config dir not documented on install page.
IDE extension. Zencoder docs mention a 'Zen CLI' runtime, but no install command/package or executable name could be confirmed. npm 'zencoder' is an unrelated video-encoding library.

Install: hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.sh | install.ps1. cask hermes-desktop is the desktop app. npm 'hermes-agent' is an UNOFFICIAL bridge (wyrtensi) and PyPI 'hermes-agent' has no project URLs tying it to Nous Research - both excluded. winget fathah.HermesDesktop is third-party. 'hermes' collides with Meta's Hermes JavaScript engine CLI.
Also installable via Nix flake github:letta-ai/letta-code.
'trae' launcher documented only by the Scoop manifest (bin\trae.cmd). winget ByteDance.TraeWork is 'TRAE SOLO'. Trae Agent (trae-cli) is a separate open-source CLI.
China edition. The v1 'trae-cn' command name is not documented in any primary source checked.

npm @sourcegraph/amp renamed to @ampcode/cli (see ampcode.com/news/npm-package-changes). Install script: ampcode.com/install.sh. Docs use 'amp version'. Chocolatey 'amp' looks stale (0.0.1753960840). cask amp-app is the macOS app. 'amp' collides with the amp.rs text editor (Homebrew formula 'amp').

Both npm packages are deprecated (@qodo/gen -> @qodo/command -> 'no longer supported'). Replacement is the Qodo Agentic Toolbox (get.qodo.ai | install.ps1), whose executable name is not stated in its docs. Codium.codium is now 'Qodo: AI Code Review'.
Install: curl -sL https://plandex.ai/install.sh | bash. Windows only via WSL. npm 'plandex' is a security placeholder; not on PyPI/Homebrew core.
Related executables: gptme-tui, gptme-util, gptme-mcp-server.

Rewritten as a fork of OpenAI Codex; install via openinterpreter.com/install | install.ps1. PyPI open-interpreter (0.4.3) is the legacy Python version. 'i' is a one-letter command - very collision-prone.
Asynchronous cloud coding agent's terminal client. Docs document 'jules version' subcommand rather than --version.

Rovo Dev runs as a subcommand: 'acli rovodev run' (auth: 'acli rovodev auth login'). acli is the general Atlassian CLI, so its presence does not prove Rovo Dev use; Appfire's older 'ACLI' also uses the name. winget Atlassian.Rovo is the Rovo desktop app. Config dir not documented on the fetched page.
Agentic terminal app; no shell command. Chocolatey 'warp' is Cloudflare WARP and Scoop main/warp is warp-packer - do not use those ids.
Install: curl -fsSL https://app.warp.dev/download/agent-cli | bash. Cask links 'warp-tui-stable' as 'warp'. 'warp' collides with Scoop main/warp (warp-packer) and Cloudflare WARP.

Editor with agent panel/ACP host. Preview channel launcher is 'zed-preview'. Chocolatey 'zed' version (1.2.1) lags. Homebrew cask zed-delta ('Delta', delta.dev) is a separate Zed Industries agent environment, not included.
Install: curl -LsSf https://mistral.ai/vibe/install.sh | bash, or 'uv tool install mistral-vibe'. winget package is the ACP-mode build (command vibe-acp). 'vibe' is a common word.

@mariozechner/pi-coding-agent is deprecated in favor of @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent; repo badlogic/pi-mono redirects to earendil-works/pi. Install: pi.dev/install.sh | install.ps1. Agent config lives in ~/.pi/agent. 'pi' is a short common name.

Install: curl -fsSL https://forgecode.dev/cli | sh. README documents both ~/forge (config/skills/agents) and FORGE_CONFIG default ~/.forge. 'forge' collides with Foundry's forge (Ethereum toolkit) and Homebrew formula 'forge' (arrayfire visualization).
Install: junie.jetbrains.com/install.sh | install.ps1. @jetbrains/junie-cli is the older npm name (last publish 2026-07); README now uses @jetbrains/junie.
npm bins: qoder (dispatcher) and qodercli. winget Alibaba.QoderCLI.CN registers 'qodercn'. QODER_CONFIG_DIR / QODER_CONFIG_DIR_NAME override config dir.
Agentic IDE. No shell launcher or config dir confirmed. Related: winget Alibaba.QoderWork, Alibaba.QoderWake.
VS Code extension now titled 'Qoder CN (Formerly Lingma)'; winget Alibaba.Lingma is the standalone Lingma IDE.
Config dir not documented in README.
Research/open-source CLI agent; installed from source with 'uv sync' (no npm/PyPI package found). Config file trae_config.yaml in the working directory.
